sources.title: Enhancing Amazon Aurora with Native Vector Search for AI-Driven ...
sources.snippet: Modern applications increasingly rely on embeddings and semantic search to power AI-driven features such as recommendation systems, chatbots, fraud detection, and personalization. While Amazon Aurora delivers exceptional performance for relational workloads, developers currently need external vector databases or extensions to manage embeddings at scale.
